{{Quote|The Scourge is the gang that took block 923, puffed-up sons of Hutts.|[[Amikab]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Scourge''' was the name of a gang imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] the gang members broke out and cut off the access to several areas of the [[Minimum Security Section]], among them [[Cell block 923]].
